    How it works & prompt engineering
    The problem
    Students turn advice into notes and to-do items manually. This agent connects natural-language requests to concrete file and database actions, with a review step.
    The prompt design
    Role prompting defines a study-action planner. A JSON contract constrains its response. Few-shot examples show valid plans. Grounding supplies existing note names and task IDs. Explicit boundaries tell it to ask for missing information instead of inventing actions.
    The safety boundary
    Code validates every command and argument independently of the prompt. Only listed actions execute. Deletion and overwriting need an extra confirmation. There is no arbitrary code or shell execution.
    What gets sent
    Live requests send your typed request, note names, and task records to Google. Note contents are not sent automatically. API keys stay in page memory and are sent only to Google. Workspace data stays in this browser’s IndexedDB; clearing browser data removes it.
    

    Built for useful actions, with human oversight.Gemini + validated commands + IndexedDB
    

    

    Connect Gemini
    Use your own Gemini API key for live requests. It stays in this tab’s memory and is never saved by this app.
    Flash-Lite is the default. Model availability and API charges depend on your Google account. Refreshing clears your key.
